flavor: A thick, oily fog clings to the floor, swirling around the base of a jagged obsidian monolith. From the shadows beyond the light, a rhythmic, wet breathing echoes, accompanied by the faint, rhythmic clinking of heavy iron chains.
name: The Silt-Choked Reliquary
reason: The party encounters a bound entity of shadow that offers forbidden knowledge in exchange for a piece of their vitality.
